text: Received the 2026 National Scholarship for the second consecutive year.
Caught in the Story, our work on narrative captivity in multi-turn LLM conversations, was accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. The preprint is now available.
Led “Yu-e-Cha” to a National Second Prize in the National E-Commerce Innovation Challenge.
PRISM, our diagnostic benchmark for LLM hallucinations, was accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference.
Received Meritorious Winner in the Mathematical Contest in Modeling (MCM/ICM).
My undergraduate innovation project was selected for the National Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program.
Won First Prize in the Chinese Mathematics Competitions.
Won Provincial First Prize in the ICBC Cup FinTech Innovation Competition.
Received National Second Prize as project lead in the National Finance Universities Innovation League.
Won Provincial First Prize in the China Undergraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling.
